name: West Columbia Christmas Tree Lighting
paras: West Columbia holds its 22nd Annual Christmas Tree Lighting on the City Hall lawn on Friday, December 4, 2026, at 6:30 pm. The evening brings holiday carols, a Christmas message, hot chocolate and cookies.

Student winners of the What Christmas Means to Me essay contest share their work, and three local school choirs perform. Mrs. Claus reads two letters picked from the ones children drop into Santa's Mailbox at Carraway Park by November 30.
tip: Children can still mail a letter to Santa at Carraway Park, 212 Hudson Street, through December 13 for a Christmas Eve reply.

name: West Columbia Holiday Parade of Lights and Parade Day
venue: 12th Street and the North Pole at the Greater CWC Chamber
when_note: Parade Day starts at noon at the North Pole, and the Holiday Parade of Lights begins at 5:30 pm along 12th Street.
paras: Parade Day in West Columbia opens at noon on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at the North Pole outside the Greater CWC Chamber office on 12th Street. The day lists live entertainment, amusements and family activities before the parade.

The Holiday Parade of Lights begins at 5:30 pm along 12th Street, when the North Pole becomes parade headquarters with a performance area and bleachers. A Snowman Stroll runs through the chamber area during the day.
tip: Arrive before 5:30 pm to get a spot near the bleachers at the North Pole.
